subject: Partner demo credits and early-termination settlement
messages:
From: Priya Kapoor <priya@orbitcloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner enablement question: demo credits & term payouts

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro last week — excited about OrbitCloud and Redwood working together. One operational item came up from our side as we finalize the SOW: how should we treat demo credits we give to prospects (trial credits applied on invoice) when calculating partner revenue share? Specifically: 

- If we apply $X in demo credits to a new customer's first invoice and that customer later churns and receives a pro-rata refund, do those credits reduce the partner payout?
- If a customer terminates during a pilot (before 90 days), do we need to clawback the partner commission proportionally?

We attached our current partner playbook so you can see how we do it today. Our legal wants consistent language in the MSA + a short operational flow so our finance teams can reconcile.

Attachment: partner_playbook_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

Can we get your suggested language or a short bullet runbook? If it helps, happy to jump on a 30-min call.

Best,
Priya Kapoor
Head of Partnerships | OrbitCloud
priya@orbitcloud.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Kapoor <priya@orbitcloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner enablement question: demo credits & term payouts

Hi Priya — great question, thanks for the playbook. Looping in Ben (revenue) and Jonas (partner ops) so we cover both the commercial and operational sides. I sketched a proposed approach below and attached a short MOP spreadsheet for reconciling credits + payouts. Also attached an initial set of MSA redlines where we call this out as "non-recoverable marketing credits" vs. "customer refunds".

My suggested approach (high level):
- Demo credits we issue as a promotional marketing credit should NOT reduce the partner's listed commission at the time of booking; instead, they should be excluded from gross billings used for commission calculations. In practice: invoice_line_items = total_charges - marketing_credits. Commission applies to invoice_line_items.
- If a customer later receives an actual monetary refund, partners are subject to a clawback on commissions paid for the refunded amount. Clawback window: 90 days (standard), pro-rata based on refund amount.
- For pilot customers (explicit pilot SOW), we recommend a shorter initial recognition: commissions are paid on realization (post-trial) or paid upfront with a 90-day clawback.

Attachments: partner_mop_draft.xlsx (Excel, 120KB); draft_msa_redlines.pdf (PDF, 340KB)

Can Ben/Jonas confirm operational feasibility and whether finance prefers a different reconciliation cadence? If you're open, I can book 30 minutes Thursday to finalize language.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priya Kapoor <priya@orbitcloud.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner enablement question: demo credits & term payouts

Marissa + Priya — quick commercial note from revenue:

I agree with Marissa's approach but want to be explicit on two items for the deal desk:
- Define "marketing/demo credits" as non-monetary adjustments that reduce billable charges before commissions are calculated. That keeps payouts predictable.
- For refunds/termination refunds, standard practice is to claw back paid commission on the refunded portion; we typically use a 70/30 split on net ARR for ISV-referred deals (Redwood/Partner) unless otherwise negotiated.

Operational asks for the MOP: include a column in the partner_mop_draft.xlsx for "adjusted_net_charge" and an audit_id referencing the invoice/refund. Finance wants a monthly reconciliation file from partner ops.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Kapoor <priya@orbitcloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner enablement question: demo credits & term payouts

Thanks — operational notes / constraints from partner ops: 

- Clawback window: 90 days is doable. We can record commission liabilities and reverse them upon refunds. We need the partner to provide the original referral ID + HubSpot deal id for any clawback calculations.
- Registration / attribution window: partner must submit lead within 30 days of first contact to qualify for referral credit.
- Reconciliation cadence: monthly automated CSV export to partner finance (we will add the "adjusted_net_charge" and "invoice_audit_id" columns).
- Exceptions: for strategic named accounts we can request an exception to the clawback window but those must be approved by Sales Leadership. If you have a specific account, include that in the ticket.

Attachment: billing_flow.drawio (diagram, 45KB)

On the MSA side, the redlines Marissa attached look fine; we'll tighten the operational appendix during onboarding.

Jonas Weber
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai

Marissa / team — thanks, this is exactly the level of detail we needed. A couple quick items: 

- OrbitCloud would prefer a 60-day clawback (we run tighter pilot cycles). Can we request a 60-day exception for our namespace? If approval needs Sales leadership sign-off, please route and we can provide a short justification (we have a pilot with CloudBend that is strategic).
- CloudBend (procurement@cloudbend.io) is on the thread; they asked whether you can provide a partner discount code and whether demo credits can be applied before the first invoice (we typically apply to the invoice but are open to pre-funded credits).

Next steps we propose:
1) Marissa/Ben/Jonas: please confirm if you can support a 60-day exception for OrbitCloud (pending leadership sign-off).
2) If yes, we'll provide the CloudBend deal id and set up a short 20-min alignment call this week to finalize MSA redlines.

Thanks again — attaching a short note with CloudBend context.

Attachment: cloudbend-context.txt (TXT, 4KB)

Best,
Priya Kapoor
Head of Partnerships | OrbitCloud
priya@orbitcloud.com
